# Catalogue

[Organization](README.md) › Catalogue

Each part of this repo that can be copied without the rest, with what it needs and its license.
The rows come from the three-row box at the top of each module's README, so the README is the place to change one.
How copying works: [Take a piece](../README.md#take-a-piece).
